text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I stop by my office before training to
find that
Satono Diamond has already
arrived. She seems
to be reading
something...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Every tiny letter on this page is packed
with a
piece of the author's feelings,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes. I received some fan mail.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Such powerful emotions have been
imbued into
the text... I can't help but
read them over and
over.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
He started a business that went under,
and his life
fell into disarray.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
He felt strong regret for putting his
family
through tough times, and was at a
complete loss
about what to do.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
But one day, he happened to see one of
my races
on TV.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The powerful desire I showed to break
my family's
jinx gave him courage.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
He's working another job now, but
continues to
plan out his next business
idea a little bit at a
time. He hasn't given
up on his dream.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Some of the writing is shaky, while some
of it
feels empowered... The name at the
end is written
incredibly neatly.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure he gathered his resolve and is
working
hard to carve a path forward,
just like I am.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. And if a kindred spirit is working
hard, then
I can't afford to drag my feet.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Now, it's time to give it my best in
training and
carve out a new path of my
own!
